description_en: Checks whether phone numbers support card SMS
description_zh: 检查手机号码是否支持卡片短信
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi check-mobiles-card-support --template-code CARD_SMS_0000 --mobiles example-string --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckMobilesCardSupport

parameters.help_en:
The code of the card SMS template.
Log on to the SMS Service console and go to the [Domestic Card SMS](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page. On the **Template Management** tab, you can view the list of card SMS templates.

>The template must be added and approved
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。
登录短信服务控制台[国内卡片短信](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面，在**模板管理**页签查看卡片短信模板列表。

>必须是已添加、并通过审核的卡片短信模板
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: The list of phone numbers to be queried
parameters.name: mobiles
